ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces of browned meat, roughly 2-3 cm, glossy brown surface with darker caramelized edges, some pale interior visible, piece shapes irregular, sitting on the upper center of the plate mixed with rice | 110
ITEM 2 | Loose grains of rice, light tan to golden with small orange and green flecks mixed in, dry and separate, scattered around the meat pieces in the upper section | 60
ITEM 3 | Wilted dark leafy greens, deep green with glossy sheen, limp and moist, a few stems, covering the right side of the plate under and beside the meat | 70
ITEM 4 | Purple-red leafy stems or cooked red-stemmed greens, dark magenta, soft and glossy, a small band beneath the meat and greens | 15
ITEM 5 | Shredded raw cabbage-like slaw, pale white and light green strands with thin orange carrot shreds and some purple cabbage bits, moist, crisp-looking, mounded on the left side of the plate | 75
ITEM 6 | Two round slices of pink-and-white striped radish, about 3-4 cm diameter, firm and crisp, one on the left under slaw and one on the right edge of the greens | 12
ITEM 7 | Fresh green leaves, bright green, flat and crisp, a few pieces tucked in the slaw at lower center of the plate | 15
